description: Explore the Muon x augmentation interaction (D007: C0074/C0075/C0077 report that Muon gains more than baseline optimizers from stronger augmentation, and that weak augmentation causes late spectral collapse). H4.1's 'weaker regularization is better at ~10 ep' was learned under SGD (E004, E011). Start from the I032 Muon base (or E025 if I032 is not kept). Change only the translate amplitude, from 2 px back to 4 px, in both resolution phases. Everything else stays fixed.
